body:
Although zyprexa is not a benzo, I want to report that doses over 50 mg taken for multiple days in a row can cause a blackout. It was similar to a klonopin blackout but during it I did not keep taking more and more like I would on benzos.
[Reported Dose: 50-80 mg
taken over 3 days in a row]
